verdict.rationale: Google publishes open-source OTP generator implementations for several mobile platforms, plus a PAM module you run on your own servers. The app can also run fully local with "Use without an account" and works offline, so you can operate it without Google's cloud. However, the core cloud-sync service has no self-hosted option, and a community user notes codes are hard to keep under their own control or export as text. Missing for 10: a self-hostable sync/backup backend, documentation for building and deploying the current app from source, and independent hands-on reports of a self-hosted setup.
